investor.title: Verification
investor.lead: Get verified once to be registered in bond issues: link your wallet, upload an identity document and tell the registrar who you are.
investor.simulated: Review is SIMULATED: there is no KYC vendor in this demo — a registrar checks the application by hand and attests your wallet on-chain (Solana Attestation Service).

wallet.title: Link your wallet
wallet.lead: Coupons are paid to this wallet and you sign subscriptions and votes with it. Linking only signs a message — no transaction, no fee.

documents.title: Upload documents
documents.lead: An identity document is required; a proof of address speeds up the review. PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB each.
documents.drop: Drop a file here or click to choose
documents.formats: PDF, PNG or JPEG · up to 10 MB
documents.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
documents.unsupported: Upload a PDF, PNG or JPEG.

details.title: Your details
details.tax: Withholding on coupons: {rate} (SIMULATED rules: residents 0 %, non-residents 15 %).
details.pending: You already have an application under review.

lead.submitted: The registrar will review your documents. You will get a notification with the decision.
lead.approved: You are verified and registered in the issues below. You can subscribe and vote from your wallet.
lead.rejected: The registrar rejected the application. Fix what the reason says and apply again.

gate.title: Create an account to get verified
gate.body: Verification belongs to an account: sign up with your email, link your wallet and send the application.
gate.demoBody: The demo investor is shared by every visitor and is already registered. Create your own account to go through verification.

registrar.title: KYC queue
registrar.lead: Applications from self-registered investors. Approving attests the wallet in the Solana Attestation Service and registers it in each requested issue.
registrar.unavailable: The queue is unavailable — the registrar API did not answer.
registrar.simulated: Review is SIMULATED: no KYC vendor; decisions are made by hand.

decision.title: Decision
decision.lead: Approve to attest the wallet and register it in every requested issue (on-chain, safe to retry), or reject with a reason the investor will see.
decision.partial: Some issues failed — the application stays under review
decision.doneApproved: Approved: the wallet is attested and registered.
decision.rejectLead: The investor sees this reason and can apply again.
